name: notify
description: A quick pop-up (toast, plus a macOS system notification) when a long Bash command or a long turn finishes, so you can stop watching it.

longCommandSeconds.title: Long command, seconds
longCommandSeconds.description: Notify when a Bash command ran at least this long (a build, a test run, an install).

longTurnSeconds.title: Long turn, seconds
longTurnSeconds.description: Notify when a whole turn ran at least this long.

systemNotification.title: Also send a macOS system notification
systemNotification.description: On macOS a toast lives inside the window; the system notification reaches you when you look at another app.
